How can I transfer digital books I have on the PC to the kindle?

A few ways:

  1. Send it to your Kindle email (assuming it's a supported format).
  2. Plug your Kindle in, drag and drop (assuming it's a supported format).
  3. Probably the best way is to use something like Calibre to manage your library of books. Calibre may support sending to Kindle through your email as well, but I've always just plugged in and transferred. Calibre will automatically convert .epub (which is a super common format that Kindles won't read) to .mobi (Kindle's native format).
